close_reason: Fixed: validate sortOrder ≤ u32::MAX in build_mailbox_from_props; added regression test
description: mailbox.rs build_mailbox_from_props line 762: n as u32 where n: u64 silently wraps. Client sends sortOrder: 5_000_000_000 → stored as 705_032_704 (5e9 mod 2^32). Fix: reject if n > u32::MAX with invalidProperties.
title: sortOrder u64→u32 silently truncates >4 294 967 295
